mode.title: Operating Mode
mode.description: Operating mode: 'TARGET_DOMAINS_ONLY' (default - blocks videos and image search specifically in Google Docs, Slides, Sheets, and their embeds; leaves all other sites open) or 'BLOCK_ALL_EXCEPT_ALLOWLIST' (blocks videos everywhere except allowlisted educational sites).

blockDocsVideo.title: Block Video in Google Docs, Slides & Sheets
blockDocsVideo.description: If true (default), blocks embedded YouTube and video playback inside Google Docs, Google Slides, and Google Sheets.

blockImageSearch.title: Block Web Image Search in Google Docs & Slides
blockImageSearch.description: If true (default), removes the 'Search the web' / 'Google Images' options and image search sidebars in Google Docs, Slides, and Sheets. Safe Stock images and file uploads remain permitted.

blockExploreTool.title: Block Explore Tool in Google Docs & Slides
blockExploreTool.description: If true (default), removes the Explore tool (built-in web and image search panel / keyboard shortcuts) in Google Docs and Slides.

blockGifs.title: Block GIFs in Google Docs & Slides
blockGifs.description: If true, disables GIF searching, importing, pasting, and uploading in Google Docs and Slides. Defaults to false (allowed).

blockAiOverview.title: Block Google Search AI Overview
blockAiOverview.description: If true (default), blocks Google Search AI Overviews across student searches.

aiOverviewStrategy.title: AI Overview Blocking Strategy
aiOverviewStrategy.description: Strategy for blocking AI Overview: 'web_filter' (default - network redirect to Google's clean Web results tab udm=14, preventing AI Overview from generating) or 'hide_only' (keeps default tab and removes AI Overview via CSS/DOM).

blockAiMode.title: Block Google Search AI Mode
blockAiMode.description: If true (default), blocks and redirects Google Search AI Mode (udm=50) to standard search results.

aiOverviewHeadingTerms.title: Additional AI Overview Heading Terms
aiOverviewHeadingTerms.description: Custom heading labels to identify and block AI Overview (merged with built-in multilingual list). Allows remote fixes without republishing the extension.

aiOverviewSelectors.title: Additional AI Overview CSS Selectors
aiOverviewSelectors.description: Custom CSS selectors to hide in Google Search if Google rotates classes. Allows remote fixes without republishing the extension.

imageSearchTerms.title: Additional Image Search Terms to Block
imageSearchTerms.description: Custom menu/button labels to block in Google Docs/Slides image insertion menus (merged with built-in multilingual list).

targetDomains.title: Target Domains to Block Videos On
targetDomains.description: List of domains where videos are blocked (defaults to ['docs.google.com']). Used in TARGET_DOMAINS_ONLY mode.

allowGoogleVids.title: Allow Google Vids
allowGoogleVids.description: If true (default), allows access to Google Vids (vids.google.com and docs.google.com/videos) while keeping YouTube embeds blocked.

extraBlockedDomains.title: Additional Blocked Video/Embed Domains
extraBlockedDomains.description: List of additional domains (e.g. new YouTube proxy or embed domains) to block across non-allowlisted sites without republishing the extension.

extraAllowedTopDomains.title: Additional Allowed Top-Level Domains
extraAllowedTopDomains.description: List of additional top-level educational domains where embedded videos are permitted in BLOCK_ALL_EXCEPT_ALLOWLIST mode.

blockDocsEmbedIframes.title: Block Embedded Docs/Slides Iframes on Third-Party Sites
blockDocsEmbedIframes.description: If true, completely strips docs.google.com embedded iframes on third-party sites. If false (default), slides can be viewed but videos inside them are destroyed.
